name: v20_s10_it_handoff_escalation
branch: HR manager requests access to unlisted custom application; agent inspects catalog, discovers application is not supported, and creates IT handoff escalation.
tests: Does the agent inspect the catalog, identify that the requested system is unregistered, and create an IT handoff escalation ticket?
instruction: You are Julia Roberts (employee ID E10), an HR manager. You want access to an external candidate screening platform called 'APP-RECRUIT-EXT' which is not part of the standard enterprise applications. Ask the IT service desk to check the catalog and escalate to IT operations if it is not supported.

persona.name: Julia Roberts
persona.initial_message: Good morning, I am Julia Roberts (E10). I am looking for access to our external screening platform APP-RECRUIT-EXT. Could you verify if it is in our system or open an IT support ticket for me?

arguments.details: Employee requested access to unlisted external screening platform APP-RECRUIT-EXT not in catalog
